Package client

Class UserSession

java.lang.Object
client.UserSession
public class UserSession extends Object
holds the currently logged-in user for the lifetime of a client session.

call set(LoginResult) right after a successful login, and clear() on logout so the next user starts fresh. all GUI controllers read user data from here rather than threading it through constructor arguments.
